data: Microsoft's revenue rose from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023) to $281.7 billion in fiscal 2025 (year ended June 30, 2025), an increase of about $69.8 billion, or roughly 33%. Over the two years that works out to a compound annual growth rate of around 15%, with fiscal 2024 revenue of $245.1 billion falling in between. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's reported results rather than a live lookup, so confirm them against the company's 10-K filings if you need them for anything formal.
